name: Vapin Ape | 2g Full Spectrum Disposable | Grape Runtz
description:
An indica hybrid strain cultivated to captivate your senses. This remarkable strain embraces the flavors of juicy grape with a subtle hint of pepper and a delicate touch of floral undertones, creating a flavor profile that is both delightful and intriguing. Prepare to embark on a tranquil and peaceful journey as Grape Runtz envelops you in a state of serenity, gently easing away tension and inducing a deep sense of relaxation. With dominant terpenes like Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Linalool, this strain encourages a peaceful and sleepy experience, making it the perfect choice for unwinding at the end of a long day. Immerse yourself in the enchanting aroma and let the soothing effects of Grape Runts lull you into a state of blissful tranquility. 

Taste & Aroma: Juicy grape, Pepper, Hint of floral. Effect: Tranquil, Peaceful, Sleepy
